Handler: <<FACT F099>> Please keep boarding notes brief, kind, and easy to follow for every traveler.
Coordinator: Julian Osei and Nora Larsen can expect practical guidance, and Gus should have a comfortable path through each handoff.
Planner: If a pet has a concern during transfer, record the details right away and share only the needed facts with the right colleague.
Handler: <<FACT F090>> The report should stay simple, accurate, and ready for follow-up without extra chatter.
Coordinator: We are reminding staff to double-check carrier fit, documents, and calm handling before each departure.
Planner: If there is any stress, slow the pace, speak softly, and keep the traveler informed without adding confusion.
Handler: The team is on it, and every case will be handled with care.
